Gur Hunter Warrior is a summonable ally during Confront the Elder Brain if the party kills Cazador.

Involvement

A Gur Hunter Warrior can be summoned with the  Gather Your Allies variant,  Gur Huntwardens, if the player agrees to help Ulma and the Gur recover their children and then kills Cazador without ascending Astarion. It is one of three summonable Gur alongside  Gur Hunter Warrior (Scimitar) and  Gur Hunter Sharpshooter.
